seen.body:
Today ANY 5xx on ANY forge call raises ForgeUnavailable and stops the whole target (no retry). A single GitHub 500 stopped two foundlings rounds. GitHub can also 500 for a longer stretch (incident), so a fixed retry count is wrong both ways.

Design (needs owner go): per-call retry with exponential backoff and jitter on 5xx and connection errors, for idempotent calls only (GET, PATCH, PUT, DELETE, GraphQL queries; never a bare create POST, which keeps its duplicate guard). Two knobs under [replication], per mirror override allowed: forge_retries (default 4, 0 = today's behaviour) with backoff 2s,4s,8s,16s capped by forge_retry_max_wait (default 60s); and forge_failure_limit (default 5): after a call exhausts its retries the item is recorded as failed and the sync CONTINUES with other items, but after forge_failure_limit consecutive items failing this way the target stops as ForgeUnavailable (an outage, not a bad item), keeping the retry-after report. Retry-After on a 5xx is honoured. qew status/sync output names retried calls and failed items. Tests: fake returns 500 once then ok (retried, no failure); 500 for one item always (item failed, rest synced, exit nonzero); 500 for everything (stops after the limit, resumable).
seen.title: A transient 5xx on one sub-issue call must not stop the whole sync
